## ✦ Before You Continue

This template is intended for issues that do **not** clearly fit another
available Gaming Horizon issue template.

Before using it, consider whether your submission would be better handled as:

```text
BUG REPORT
FEATURE REQUEST
DOCUMENTATION ISSUE
IMPROVEMENT
SECURITY REPORT
```

If another dedicated template matches your issue, use that template instead.

Please confirm:

- [ ] I searched existing open issues.
- [ ] I searched relevant closed issues.
- [ ] I checked whether another issue template better matches this topic.
- [ ] This issue relates directly to The Gaming Horizon or its repository.
- [ ] I removed private and sensitive information.
- [ ] This issue is appropriate for public discussion.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Security vulnerabilities that require confidential disclosure should not be
> reported through this public template. Follow the repository Security Policy.

## ✦ Project Scope Check

The Gaming Horizon is a **browser-first gaming ecosystem**.

This issue should not assume Gaming Horizon is currently:

```text
A CLOUD GAMING SERVICE
A GAME-STREAMING SERVER
A DESKTOP GAME LAUNCHER
A DOWNLOAD CLIENT
A QUEUE-BASED STREAMING PLATFORM
```

unless current maintained project documentation explicitly establishes such a
capability.

Please confirm:

- [ ] My issue reflects the documented scope of The Gaming Horizon.
- [ ] I have separated current project capabilities from future ideas.

---

## ✦ Truthfulness Check

Please confirm:

- [ ] I have separated observed facts from assumptions.
- [ ] I am not presenting a proposal as an approved roadmap commitment.
- [ ] I am not claiming an unverified partnership or sponsorship.
- [ ] I am not presenting conceptual artwork as product evidence.
- [ ] I am not presenting outdated interface text as current project truth.

---

## ✦ Security Validation

Before submitting, confirm:

- [ ] No passwords are included.
- [ ] No API keys are included.
- [ ] No access tokens are included.
- [ ] No private keys are included.
- [ ] No session secrets are included.
- [ ] No database credentials are included.
- [ ] No recovery codes are included.
- [ ] No sensitive webhook information is included.
- [ ] No private user information is included.
- [ ] This issue can safely be discussed publicly.

> [!CAUTION]
> If any of these cannot be confirmed, review the report before publishing.

## ✦ Review Flow

After submission, an issue may move through a process similar to:

```text
                     CUSTOM ISSUE
                          │
                          ▼
                        TRIAGE
                          │
             ┌────────────┼────────────┐
             │            │            │
             ▼            ▼            ▼
           VALID      NEEDS INFO    DUPLICATE
             │            │            │
             └───────┬────┘            │
                     ▼                 │
                   REVIEW              │
                     │                 │
           ┌─────────┼─────────┐       │
           ▼         ▼         ▼       │
        DISCUSS   IMPLEMENT   DEFER     │
           │         │         │       │
           └─────────┼─────────┘       │
                     ▼                 │
                   RESOLVE ◄───────────┘
                     │
                     ▼
                    CLOSE
```

Actual repository labels and decisions determine the formal lifecycle.

---

## ✦ Possible Outcomes

A custom issue may ultimately become:

```text
ACCEPTED
RESOLVED
IMPLEMENTED
DOCUMENTED
DEFERRED
DUPLICATE
NEEDS INFORMATION
OUT OF SCOPE
DECLINED
CLOSED
```

Not every issue requires code changes.

Some may be resolved through:

```text
DOCUMENTATION
DISCUSSION
CONFIGURATION
CLARIFICATION
DESIGN DECISION
REPOSITORY MAINTENANCE
```

---

## ✦ Submission Quality

A strong custom issue should be:

| Standard | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Clear** | Its purpose is understandable |
| **Focused** | Covers one primary topic |
| **Relevant** | Relates directly to Gaming Horizon |
| **Contextual** | Provides enough background |
| **Actionable** | Gives reviewers something concrete to evaluate |
| **Safe** | Contains no sensitive information |
| **Respectful** | Follows repository conduct standards |
| **Truthful** | Separates facts, assumptions, and proposals |
| **Searchable** | Uses meaningful terminology |
| **Maintainable** | Creates useful long-term repository history |

---

## ✦ Final Checklist

Before submitting:

- [ ] I searched open issues.
- [ ] I searched relevant closed issues.
- [ ] I checked whether another template is more appropriate.
- [ ] I wrote a clear title.
- [ ] I provided a clear issue summary.
- [ ] I identified the affected area where possible.
- [ ] I explained the current situation.
- [ ] I explained the desired outcome.
- [ ] I provided relevant context.
- [ ] I included evidence only where useful.
- [ ] I removed sensitive information.
- [ ] I completed the security validation.
- [ ] I completed the truthfulness check.
- [ ] I reviewed the issue before submitting it.

## ✦ Contributor Conduct

Participation in this issue is expected to follow:

```text
CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
SECURITY.md
```

Keep discussion:

```text
CLEAR
PROFESSIONAL
RESPECTFUL
RELEVANT
CONSTRUCTIVE
```

Technical disagreement is acceptable.

Personal attacks, harassment, spam, or disruptive behavior are not.
